title: Direct (Scope 1) GHG emissions
rationale: All required elements for GRI 305-1 are supported by the cited passages except biogenic CO2, which is not mentioned.

title: Energy indirect (Scope 2) GHG emissions
missing_elements: Market-based Scope 2 figure (applies where contractual instruments are used)
rationale: Location-based Scope 2 value (21,940 tCO2e) and FY2025 period are shown in tables. Operational control boundary, GHG Protocol methodology and UK Government emission factors are explicitly stated. No market-based Scope 2 figure is provided, only mention of renewable electricity purchases.

title: Other indirect (Scope 3) GHG emissions
missing_elements: Gross Scope 3 emissions value (tCO2e); Reporting period stated with the figure
rationale: The passages confirm categories and methodology but state that Scope 3 emissions are not yet quantified and no period is linked to a figure, so value and period elements are not satisfied.

title: GHG emissions intensity
rationale: The report provides the GHG intensity ratio of 0.172 tCO2e/tonne product for FY2025, specifies the denominator as tonnes of product, and states the ratio covers Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions.

title: Reduction of GHG emissions
rationale: All required elements are directly addressed in the reduction statement on page 7, which provides the amount, baseline year (2024), Scope 1 coverage, and description of the kiln heat‑recovery and electric loader initiatives.

title: Energy consumption within the organization
rationale: Total energy consumption has conflicting figures (412,300 MWh vs 1,532,000 GJ), making the element unclear. Fuel consumption (natural gas) and electricity consumption are clearly disclosed (ev_9a05509046d0fdf4976b, ev_8a83c082837f5a593f30). Reporting period FY2025 is stated with the figures (ev_43ee3ac9fd3662700e82). Source of conversion factors is provided (ev_b24b03dc6f8c1f4e99dd).

title: Energy intensity
rationale: The report provides the energy intensity ratio of 1.01 MWh/tonne for FY2025, specifies the denominator as electricity consumed within the organization, and states that the intensity covers fuel and electricity consumed within the organization.

title: Reduction of energy consumption
rationale: The passage ev_f38d48c444a257dbd8bd provides the reduction amount, baseline year, and identifies natural gas as the energy type, satisfying all three required elements.

title: External assurance
rationale: The report states the 2025 data were not externally assured and that limited assurance will be sought for Scope 1 and 2 emissions in 2026, satisfying the statement and scope elements. No assurance standard is disclosed.
